marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 20 knots increasing to east 35 early this evening
then diminishing to east 25 Saturday evening. Scattered flurries changing to snow Saturday
morning. Temperatures near minus 3. Outside the ice edge freezing spray beginning this evening and
ending Saturday evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 to 2 metres.<br/>
